user.title: Add a target
user.description: Monitor a TCP service without relying on ICMP/ping.

data_description.name: Friendly name used for the Home Assistant device.
data_description.host: DNS name or IP address reachable from Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure target
reconfigure.description: Change the target name, host, or TCP port.

error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address, not a URL.

abort.already_configured: That host and TCP port are already being monitored.

init.title: Monitoring options
init.description: Tune polling, retry/debounce behavior, grouping, and latency thresholds.

data_description.group: Optional label used by HA Probulator overview and summary cards.
data_description.icon: Icon used by target entities and custom cards.
data_description.timeout: Seconds allowed for each TCP connection attempt.
data_description.retries: Extra attempts within a probe cycle after the first attempt fails.
data_description.retry_delay: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.
data_description.failure_threshold: Consecutive failed probe cycles required before the target becomes offline.
data_description.recovery_threshold: Consecutive successful probe cycles required before the target becomes online again.
data_description.warning_latency_ms: Response time at or above this value is considered degraded.
data_description.critical_latency_ms: Response time at or above this value is considered critical.
data_description.statistics_window: Number of probe cycles retained for rolling latency and success-rate calculations.

error.critical_must_exceed_warning: Critical latency must be greater than warning latency.
